Use this template to create a section with 2 or more columns.

To begin the columns, type {{t|Columns|# of columns}}, e.g. <nowiki>{{Columns|3}}</nowiki>. It will default to 2 columns.

To end the columns, type <nowiki>{{</nowiki>'''Columns|end'''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>.

Example - enter the following:
<pre>
{{Columns|4}}

desired content here

{{Columns|end}}
</pre>
To get this:
{{Columns|4}}

If the column widths need to maintain a certain width, the minimum width can be increased by using "widths", e.g. <nowiki>{{</nowiki>'''Columns|3|widths=150px'''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>. (Replace 150px with desired number. It defaults to 100px.)

The "gap" value between the columns can also be adjusted (default is 15px).
